text: In July 2015 we spoke most often of "the 21st century cures act," which 64 of us said, peaking on 2015-07-10; Michael T. McCaul said it first, on 2015-01-27. Fifty-four of us said "the middle east," first said by Virginia Foxx. Around the fourteenth we converged on Iran: 52 of us said "deal with iran," and 51 of us said "agreement with iran," which John Barrasso said first. Later that month, 43 of us said "need of scrutiny," and 42 of us said "the executive in need of scrutiny," "regulations from the executive," and "from the executive in need of," each first said by Tim Walberg. We record that these phrases moved together, and that we said them in these numbers, on these days. We are the report of what we repeated.
